reviews.shade: COSRX The 6 Peptide Skin Booster Serum 150mL
reviews.text: his is an excellent serum. It has a very lightweight, water-based texture that feels comfortable on the skin. I like to use it in the morning before applying my creams — it enhances their effectiveness. I also really love this brand. Very satisfied with this purchase.
reviews.zh: 呢款精華真係超讚。質地好輕盈，係水基底，搽上面好舒服。我鍾意喺朝早搽完面霜之前用，可以加強面霜嘅效果。我亦都好鍾意呢個品牌。對今次購物好滿意。

reviews.shade: COSRX The 6 Peptide Skin Booster Serum 150mL
reviews.text: I put off trying this product for so long and I regret it! This product is so hydrating, absorbs well and nourishes my skin. The only thing I don't like is if I use too much it is a little sticky. I recommend one pump for face and one for chest/ neck. Peptides were the missing ingredient in my skin care routine especially since I'm over 30 now. Highly recommend!
reviews.zh: 我拖咗好耐先試呢款產品，後悔冇早啲買！呢款產品保濕效果超好，吸收快又養膚。唯一唔鍾意嘅係用太多嘅話會有少少黏。建議面用一泵，胸口/頸用一泵。對我嚟講，peptides 一直係護膚程序入面缺少嘅成分，尤其而家我都過咗30歲。大力推薦！

reviews.shade: COSRX The 6 Peptide Skin Booster Serum 150mL
reviews.text: I want to love this! But I think it caused my skin to burn, similar to a chemical burn. No odor but I think I might be a bit strong for sensitive, acne-prone skin.
reviews.zh: 我好想鍾意佢！但我覺得佢令到我塊皮膚灼傷，好似化學燒傷咁。冇味，但我覺得對敏感肌同暗瘡肌嚟講可能太刺激。

reviews.shade: COSRX The 6 Peptide Skin Booster Serum 150mL
reviews.text: I've been using this for almost a week, and I really like the texture. It's very lightweight and absorbs quickly. I have large pores, and it has really helped tighten them and hydrate my skin. Definitely will purchase again.
reviews.zh: 我差不多用咗一個禮拜，真心鍾意佢嘅質地。好輕盈，吸收得快。我毛孔粗大，佢真係幫到我收毛孔同保濕。一定會再回購。

reviews.shade: COSRX The 6 Peptide Skin Booster Serum 150mL
reviews.text: Within a short period, I've noticed a positive transformation in my skin's appearance. It looks more radiant, feels firmer, and has a healthy glow. The COSRX 6X Peptide Collagen Booster Toner Serum has become an integral part of my quest for youthful and healthy skin.
reviews.zh: 好短時間入面，我已經見到皮膚外觀有明顯改善。望落更有光澤，摸落更緊緻，有健康嘅光感。COSRX 6X Peptide Collagen Booster Toner Serum 已經成為我追求年輕健康肌膚不可或缺嘅一部分。

reviews.shade: COSRX The 6 Peptide Skin Booster Serum 150mL
reviews.text: I use this product as the first step in my skin care routine. It's very watery, more like a toner than a typical serum consistency. It absorbs very fast and it goes well with other types of serum, ampules or lotion.
reviews.zh: 我將呢款產品用喺護膚程序嘅第一步。佢好水潤，質地比起一般精華更似爽膚水。吸收得好快，同其他類型嘅精華、ampoule 或者乳液都好夾。

reviews.shade: COSRX The 6 Peptide Skin Booster Serum 150mL
reviews.text: I was not sure if this is really worth but ordered to see the result by myself. Wow this really makes difference when I use it with Vitamin c or retinol products! I regret I only bought one. I should stock up some soon!
reviews.zh: 本來唔太肯定呢款係咪真係值得，但買咗返嚟自己試下。嘩，同維他命C或者retinol 產品一齊用真係有好大分別！後悔淨係買咗一支。要快啲入多幾支貨！

reviews.shade: COSRX The 6 Peptide Skin Booster Serum 150mL
reviews.text: First time of using this, it has a runny texture, absorb to my skin quickly but still hydrating and give me a glowing effect. I trust Cosrx because I use a lot of Cosrx products from the cleanser, essence and the cream.
reviews.zh: 第一次用，質地好水，吸收得好快但仍然有保濕，畀到我水光效果。我信 Cosrx 因為我已經用咗好多 Cosrx 嘅產品，由洗面奶、精華到面霜。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
